faq.title: General Questions
faq.desc: Learn how Nota is redefining on-chain financial interaction.
faq.q1: How does Nota differ from traditional POS systems?
faq.a1: Unlike traditional POS systems (like Moka or static QRIS), Nota integrates on-chain stablecoin payments directly into digital accounting. There are no expensive MDR fees, settlement is instant, and every transaction builds your financial reputation on the blockchain.
faq.q2: Do I need a crypto wallet?
faq.a2: Yes, you need a wallet like MetaMask or OKX Wallet connected to the Arc Testnet. Nota is non-custodial, meaning you maintain full control over your funds and private keys at all times.
faq.q3: Why Arc Testnet and how do Gas Fees work?
faq.a3: Arc is a high-performance EVM-compatible network where gas fees are paid directly in Native USDC. This eliminates the need to hold secondary gas tokens like ETH.
faq.q4: How does Nota protect my business privacy?
faq.a4: Nota uses a Hybrid Privacy architecture: sensitive item details and notes are securely stored off-chain in Supabase protected by per-wallet RLS, while transaction validity is anchored on the Arc blockchain via a cryptographic hash (dataHash).
faq.q5: Is Split Bill processed On-Chain or Off-Chain?
faq.a5: Split Bill on Nota is processed Fully On-Chain. The smart contract tracks participants, share amounts, payment status, and settles USDC funds transparently.
faq.a6: Nota Score is an on-chain financial reputation rating derived from your transaction history and repayment discipline, serving as a trust metric for Arc DeFi ecosystems.
faq.q7: How does IDR & USDC currency conversion work?
faq.a7: While settlement is conducted in USDC, Nota offers real-time IDR conversion via live rate oracles to simplify pricing for Indonesian merchants and customers.
faq.q8: Is my catalog and transaction data secure on Supabase?
faq.a8: Yes. Every Supabase request is authenticated using cryptographic wallet signatures (Wallet-based JWT Auth) and isolated using Row Level Security (RLS) so only the wallet owner can access their data.
